perf(unplugin-dts): skip watch target resolution in one-shot builds (#494)

* perf(unplugin-dts): skip watch target resolution in one-shot builds

addRuntimeWatchTargets resolved real paths for every program source file on each
buildStart, even when the bundler was not watching. It now returns early when the build
context reports `meta.watchMode === false`, and resolves the root's real path once per
call instead of once per file.

* test(unplugin-dts): cover watch target preparation boundaries
